Melee Weapon Traits

  • Attachable: Can be mounted to a larger weapon to inflict the damage listed in parentheses.
  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Bludgeon: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Bludgeon) Skill.
  • Conceal: This weapon can be concealed easily, granting +1Dm when attempting to hide the weapon.
  • Large: The weapon cannot be used in an area smaller than short distance without incurring -2DM.
  • One-Handed: This melee weapon can only be used in one-hand.
  • Throw: This weapon can be thrown up to x2 DEX metres.
  • Two-Handed: This melee weapon required two hands to use properly; otherwise incur -2DM.

Stock Arms Ammo

  • Cost: Each round costs 10cr.
  • Weight: Each round weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Ranged Weapon Ammunition Types

  • Solid: A typical round of solid ammunition. Solid ammo has a chance to penetrate through a target if the damage exceeds 12 wounds.
  • Spread-Shot: Shotguns can use either Spread ammo or Solid ammo. Spread ammo provides the Spread trait but decreases the weapon’s range from Long to Medium. Spread ammo is typically used for boarding actions on starships to prevent hull damage to the ship. Spread shot can only be used for weapons with the Spread trait. x2 cost and x2 weight.
  • Hollow-Point: Hollow-point rounds prevent penetrating a target regardless of the damage output but deal an additional +1 damage for every 1D rolled for damage. x3 Cost per round.
  • Armour-Piercing: Armour-piercing rounds decrease the target's Armour by -1, to a minimum of 8+ to hit. x2 cost per round.

Ranged Weapon Descriptions

  • Body Pistol: A small and easily concealable firearm. Gain +1DM to conceal this weapon if needed.
  • Auto-Pistol: This weapon is a one-handed firearm capable of auto-fire.
  • Revolver: The revolver is an older but reliable firearm. Ignore weapon-jamming if a 2 is rolled on an attack.
  • Snub Pistol: Similar to a body pistol but is designed to be used in low gravity situations by preventing recoil.
  • Gauss Pistol: This weapon accelerates the round using electromagnetic power to provide more damage.
  • Carbine: An easy-to-use ranged weapon for those less experienced. If used by someone untrained in Ranged Combat (stock), they can instead can use their Ranged Combat (short) Skill in its place.
  • Piercing: This weapon reduces the Armour of the target by the listed number, to a minimum of 8+ to hit.
  • Shotgun: A powerful weapon popular for ship defense and boarding. Shotguns can be loaded with Spread ammo.
  • Rifle: A common firearm used for hunting, survival, and defense. Rifles are ideal for long-range use.
  • Semi-Auto Rifle: An entry-level military firearm, This weapon is capable of firing two rounds at a time within long range.
  • Sub-Machine Gun: A destructive military firearm capable of firing four rounds at a time.
  • Gauss Rifle: Similar to the gauss pistol, but applied to a rifle.

Book p.31

pages.html:
Energy: Energy weapons use concentrated energy beams fired in a fraction of a second. All energy weapons can only be fired once every 10-second round due to the extreme cooling needed to prevent burning out the weapon.

  • Zero-G: All Energy weapons gain the Zero-G trait.

Energy Ammo: Energy packs weigh 1kg and contain 25 shots. Each pack costs 200cr. Weapons contain enough slots for multiple energy packs, equal to the maximum number of rounds they can fire. For example, a laser pistol can only hold one pack while a laser rifle can hold up to four energy packs. Keep in mind that it will increase the weight of the weapon for every additional energy pack installed on the weapon.

  • Tasers and EM disruptors use smaller energy packs that weigh 500g and contain 4 rounds.

pages.name: Ranged Weapon Traits
pages.html:
• Arching: This weapon can be fired in an arching trajectory, allowing it to decrease any cover bonus for the target by 1 step.
  • Auto #: A weapon with Auto allows it to be fired at a number of different targets during the same combat round, equal to the Auto number. The weapon always fires this amount of rounds anytime it is used.
    • Multiple targets: For every interval of Auto , the penalty to firing at multiple targets is -1DM against up to two targets. For example, an SMG (Auto 5) can be used to attack up to five different targets in a round which incur -5DM per attack.
    • Single target: If the character prefers to fire at a single target, the Auto number is applied as additional damage to the target on a hit. For example, firing an auto-pistol at a single target deals +2 damage in addition to the 2D damage.
    • Suppression: If using an Auto weapon to suppress, then the suppression attempt gains +DM equal to the Auto number.
  • Shafted: The ammunition used for this weapon are shafted missiles that can be used to transport additional effects, such as poison, minor explosives, or other items as allowed by the referee.
  • Conceal: This weapon can be concealed easily, granting +1DM when attempting to hide the weapon.
  • Low-Tech: Low-Tech weapons require additional focus in using them properly, with wind, temperature, moisture, etc., being factors in the weapons efficiency. Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Range (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM to use it.
  • Piercing: This weapon reduces the Armour of the target by the listed number, to a minimum of 8+ to hit.
  • Overload: This energy weapon can be charged to deal more damage. For every round the weapon is charged, it will deal an automatic additional +1 wound at the cost of an additional round. Energy weapons can only overcharge equal to the amount of additional energy packs installed on the weapon. For example, a laser carbine can only overcharge for one round and deal an additional +1 wounds, while a laser rifle can overcharge for 3 rounds and deal up to +3 wounds on a hit.
  • Slow Reload: It takes two full rounds to reload this firearm.
  • Spread: This weapon is capable of using Spread ammo.
    • Decreased Range: When using Spread ammo, decrease the weapon’s effective range by one range band.
    • Damage Spread: When using Spread ammo, apply a -1DM per target in range, where any success takes an equal amount of damage divided by the number of targets fired at in a v-shape area from the weapon. For example, firing at three targets in medium range in the same area will have the attacker incur -3DM. If the attack successfully hits two of them, then the damage is rolled and split evenly between both hit targets.
  • Stun: The target of a stun weapon must make an END check of 8+ to prevent being rendered helpless. The target is Stunned for a number of 10 minute intervals equal to 1+ the effect of the roll.
  • Thrown: Any item can be thrown to inflict harm. The character adds their STR modifier to thrown attacks AND damage. However, the character cannot throw an item more than 1kg per +1DM STR modifier. Each additional 1kg of weight an item has deals D3 damage.
  • Unreliable: If this weapon misfires, it takes D3 rounds to reset it to be usable again.
  • Zero-G: Using this firearm prevents recoil, allowing it to be used in low-to-no gravity without incurring future penalties to attacks due to drifting.

Armour Traits

  • Absorbing: This armour negates the first attack that hits that deals between 2D-6D of damage, but is destroyed in the process. Once the armor is destroyed, the wearer is considered unarmoured (8+ to hit). This armour is considered disposable and cannot be repaired.
  • Reflective: Reflects energy weapons away from the wearer but is downgraded to Jack armour after deflecting 2D-6D damage. This armour can be repaired to be reflective again for 250cr.
  • Vaccsuit: This armour functions as a vaccsuit as well as protection in combat. Battledress functions as a vaccsuit of TL 14.
